title: Weekly scan
summary: There is about 22 GB of space you can get back, and none of it has been touched yet. Everything listed here is a file Windows or a program can rebuild by itself, so removing it costs you nothing but the time it takes to rebuild.

sections.heading: What I did not touch
items: Anything under Documents/, Desktop/ or OneDrive/
Any file changed in the last 14 days
Program installs — this bot never uninstalls anything

sections.heading: How to get it back
sections.body:
Nothing is deleted. Files are moved into a dated folder under C:\DiskCleanupQuarantine and stay there until you say otherwise.

To undo a batch, run restore.ps1 with the batch date, or press Restore next to it in the control plane. Permanent deletion is purge.ps1, which only runs from a terminal and asks you to type a confirmation.

holding: 22.4 GB is staged but not moved — this was a dry run, so the live weekly run is what will move it.
